argon.check_detail: From Witness B's marked position (Depo Witness B 41:10, 52:00, 1:54:30 (Exhibit 4 mark #2)) the line of sight to veh_A is blocked by veh_T_tractor at t=9.8s (distance 30.2 m). Blocked from 21 of 25 positions within 2 m of Witness B's mark; the result depends on Witness B's exact position. Claim: "I had a clear view of the car the whole way in. I watched it right up until the moment it hit. Nothing was in the way."
argon.critique_summary: Witness B's testimony that she had a clear, unobstructed view of Vehicle A all the way to impact is contradicted by her own marked position on Exhibit 4.
